description: An unresolvable argument floors, and the diagnostic names the parameter and where the body enters it — enough to act on from the CI log alone. Reading the argument off an `any` floors too, on its own line of reasoning: the type cannot rule out a getter there either.

diagnostics.message: Call to `myEach` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is non-throwing given `cb`, and the argument passed for it does not resolve to a function this engine can color, so nothing can say whether it throws. `myEach` enters `cb` at src/index.ts:3. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@nothrow/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.

Reading `config.onEach` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the checker cannot resolve `config.onEach` to a declaration, so nothing can say whether a body runs here. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@nothrow/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
